title: Ajaia Product Roadmap & Vision 2027
content:
Ajaia Product Roadmap & Vision

Welcome to the core product planning document for the Ajaia Collaborative Platform. This document outlines our major product milestones, design decisions, and upcoming launches.

1. Executive Summary

Our mission is to empower distributed teams to draft, iterate, and ship mission-critical ideas at lightning speed. We are building an AI-native workspace combining rich collaborative editing with proactive context retrieval.

2. Key Pillars

  • Instant Synchronous Editing: Zero perceptible lag and robust offline tolerance.
  • Intelligent Context: Semantic file indexing for rich attachments and cross-document references.
  • Seamless Team Collaboration: Transparent ownership and granular role-based sharing (Editor vs. Viewer).

3. Q1 Launch Checklist

  • Complete rich-text TipTap WYSIWYG core integration

  • Multi-format file upload (.md, .txt, .docx ingestion)

  • Role-based document sharing (Viewer / Editor enforcement)

  • Multiplayer cursor sync using WebSockets / CRDT

"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication. Ship the focused core before spreading into complex periphery."

title: RFC 042: High Performance Document Storage & Sync
content:
RFC 042: High Performance Document Storage & Sync

Author: Sarah Chen, Principal Architect
Status: Approved for Implementation

1. Problem Statement

Traditional document editors face challenges when balancing quick local responsiveness with server persistence. When multiple team members work on a document, latency and conflict resolution must be handled gracefully.

2. Architectural Decisions

  1. Structured Content Storage: We preserve rich text formatted as clean HTML/JSON nodes, enabling fast roundtrips and standard web accessibility.

  2. Role-Based Access Boundaries: Permissions are strictly verified at both API endpoints and client controls. Viewers are blocked from mutation payloads.

  3. Pluggable Storage Layer: A decoupled file-backed repository pattern that seamlessly upgrades to Postgres or Neon in production.

// Pseudocode: Permission Check
function canEdit(doc, user) {
  if (doc.ownerId === user.id) return true;
  return doc.collaborators.some(c => c.userId === user.id && c.role === 'editor');
}

title: Ajaia Design System & Typography Guidelines
content:
Ajaia Design System & Typography

Guidelines for building clean, usable productivity interfaces at Ajaia.

Visual Hierarchy

The document editor must prioritize clarity and minimize chrome clutter. The page should feel like high-grade stationery with smooth typography.

  • Font Family: Clean sans-serif with readable monospace for code
  • Document Margins: 64px desktop padding resembling physical paper sheets
  • Status Signals: Subtle save pill with clear feedback: Saved, Saving, Error
